name: The Lost Pilot
summary: Pilot Hammerfoot fears the worst for his comrade, Mori Hildelve, who ventured into the craggy hills of Dun Morogh on foot after wrecking his siege engine. Hildelve was searching for a rare ore vital for potent blastpowder, but days have passed amidst unsettling roars echoing through the peaks.

sections.title: A Search Cut Short
sections.body: Dwarven siege engines are formidable war machines, but even iron treads struggle against the treacherous, jagged ridges of Dun Morogh. While scouring the slopes for a rare mineral deposit required to produce high-grade blastpowder, Pilot Mori Hildelve pushed his engine too far up a steep hill and busted the machine. Undeterred by the breakdown, Hildelve ordered his companion, Pilot Hammerfoot, to stay behind and guard the broken machinery while he pressed higher into the frozen wilderness on foot.

sections.title: Echoes in the Snow
sections.body: Days went by with no sign of Hildelve returning to camp. In the dead of night, strange and vicious beastly growls began echoing down from the rocky crags, turning Hammerfoot's mild impatience into creeping dread. Though Hildelve had a reputation for being as tough as nails, surviving the frigid heights of Dun Morogh without mechanized armor or heavy support against prowling predators is a dangerous gamble.

sections.title: A Grim Discovery
sections.body: Following Hildelve's path up the slopes leads not to a stranded scout, but to a frozen tragedy. The dwarf's remains lie exposed to the elements, mauled and stripped by mountain scavengers. Clutched tightly in his lifeless hand are his roughly scribbled notes—and still draped over his ruined frame is his brigadier's vest, confirming that the brave siege engineer met an untimely and violent end.

faq.q: Why was Pilot Hildelve out in the wilderness alone?
faq.answer: Hildelve was searching for a rare type of ore needed to craft high-grade dwarven blastpowder. When his siege engine broke down on a steep mountain slope, he chose to press on into the crags on foot rather than abandon the prospect.

faq.q: Who sends you to look for Hildelve?
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot, Hildelve's friend and fellow siege engine operator, asks travelers to investigate. He was ordered to stay behind and guard their damaged machinery while Hildelve scouted ahead.

faq.q: What happened to Hildelve's siege engine?
faq.answer: Hildelve attempted to pilot his heavy machine straight up a steep, icy hillside while scouting for ore, wrecking its mechanics and stranding it in the snow.
Hammerfoot has heard beastly growls in the hills and fears for Hildelve. The pilot's fate is discovered by following his trail.

faq.q: What proof is found at Hildelve's remains?
faq.answer: Hammerfoot asks you to find Hildelve after he continued the ore search on foot. Any evidence of what happened to him is uncovered at the end of the search.

faq.q: What happens after Hildelve's body is discovered?
faq.answer: Finding Hildelve reveals what happened during his search. The investigation then continues with the evidence found there.

angles.text: The loss of a skilled Siege Engine driver to wild beasts hits close to home, underscoring the lethal dangers that linger even in Khaz Modan's backyard.
Hildelve's expedition highlights the relentless dwarven search for volatile minerals to refine potent explosives and blastpowder.
